steps.analysis: 127 non-empty combinations of seven cell-type features
steps.score: Minimum of Cohort2 slide-LOSO AUC and Cohort3 AUC
steps.selection_rule: Minimum feature count among combinations with score >= 0.85; ties use higher score, higher mean AUC, then smaller AUC gap.

optional_cohort6_cell_reconstruction.input_availability: Raw clinical mIHC cell tables and images are external. The default workflow starts from the bundled TLS compositions.

input_units.cell_percentages: 0-100; denominator is all included cells within each TLS.
input_units.pseudo_marker_folds: Marker intensity divided by its base threshold; cell_rule.json supplies the multipliers.
input_units.pseudo_cell_row_id: Zero-based row index in the source cell table; unique within each cohort/TLS membership.
input_units.pseudo_membership: Cell centroids intersecting the matched TLS union polygon.
input_units.pseudo_polygon_cell_count: Polygon count used for eligibility; prediction denominators are calculated from the supplied cell membership.

reproduction_boundaries.pseudo_mIHC: Starts from matched TLS polygons and segmented cell marker folds. Segmentation, base-threshold estimation and initial TLS matching are upstream inputs.
reproduction_boundaries.cohort6: TLS-level method comparison using the same TLS population for both methods.
